title: 형사 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:6:0:00006:part:1/1
title_original: 형사 판결서 등의 열람 및 복사에 관한 규칙
full_text:
Article 6 (Restrictions on Inspection and Copying)
(1) Where any ground specified in the subparagraphs of Article 59-3 (1) of the Act exists, court officials, etc. may restrict inspection and copying of judgments, etc. concerning judgments rendered by the court to which they belong, and judgments of higher or lower courts or judgments subject to retrial in relation thereto.
(2) A litigation participant may, pursuant to the proviso of Article 59-3 (1) 5 of the Act, apply to court officials, etc. of the court retaining the litigation records (or, after the judgment becomes final and conclusive, the court that pronounced the judgment) for restrictions on inspection and copying of judgments, etc. under paragraph (1). In such cases, no third party may apply to inspect or copy those judgments, etc. until a decision on the application becomes final and conclusive.
(3) Where inspection and copying are restricted under paragraph (1) or the proviso of paragraph (2), a litigation participant or interested third party may, after the judgment becomes final and conclusive, apply to court officials, etc. of the court that pronounced the judgment for inspection and copying of judgments, etc., by demonstrating justifiable grounds.
(4) A person dissatisfied with a decision by court officials, etc. denying an application under paragraph (2), or with a decision on an application under paragraph (3), may apply for revocation or alteration of the decision to the court to which those officials belong (or, where that court is the Supreme Court, to the court that rendered the second-instance judgment): Provided, That an application for revocation or alteration of a decision denying an application under paragraph (2) shall be made within three days after notice of the decision is received; in such cases, Articles 417 and 418 of the Act shall apply mutatis mutandis.
